title: Bean Soup with Zucchini, Kale, Red Peppers, Avocado & Tortilla Chips

steps.text: Wash, dry, trim, and small dice zucchini. Place in a medium bowl.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, drain and roughly chop roasted peppers. Add to the bowl with the zucchini.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies start to soften, 2-3 minutes.
When the veggies are soft, add beans and broth to the pot; stir to combine the soup and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer until beans are tender, 3-4 minutes.

Add kale to the pot in handfuls, waiting for the kale to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until kale is tender, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, halve, and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and small dice.
To serve, divide soup between bowls; top with tortilla chips and avocado. Enjoy!
